requirements.quote: Members, officers, staff, and employees of the Syracuse Regional Airport Authority may respond to this RFP only in accordance with the Authority’s Code of Ethics.
requirements.text: Respondents must comply with the Authority's Code of Ethics.

requirements.quote: The selected Contractor shall be required to purchase at its own cost and expense and maintain at all times for the duration of the contract with the Authority, insurance coverage as specified below.
requirements.text: Contractor must maintain specified insurance coverage during the contract.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall obtain and for the duration of the contract, maintain a Commercial General Liability insurance policy including contractual liability coverage, with minimum limits of:
requirements.text: Contractor must maintain Commercial General Liability insurance with specified limits.

requirements.quote: • Bodily Injury and Property Damage Limit $1,000,000 each occurrence
requirements.text: Insurance must include $1,000,000 per occurrence for bodily injury and property damage.
Insurance must include $2,000,000 aggregate for products/completed operations.

requirements.quote: • Personal Injury & Advertising Injury Limit $4,000,000 each person/organization
requirements.text: Insurance must include $4,000,000 per person/organization for personal injury and advertising injury.

requirements.quote: • General Aggregate $4,000,000 applicable on a per project basis
requirements.text: Insurance must include $4,000,000 general aggregate per project.

requirements.quote: The General Liability policy shall name the Authority and the City of Syracuse and their respective members, officers, staff, and employees as additional insureds for both ongoing and completed operations.
requirements.text: General Liability policy must name the Authority and City of Syracuse as additional insureds.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall obtain and maintain workers' compensation and employer's liability insurance policy or policies covering its obligations in accordance with the provisions of New York Workers' Compensation Law, including Article 9 of New York Workers' Compensation Law, known as the Disability Benefits Law, and any and all rules, regulations and procedures promulgated pursuant to the New York Workers' Compensation Law.
requirements.text: Contractor must maintain workers' compensation and employer's liability insurance as per New York law.
